description: This file defines security-related middleware functions for a Node.js Express backend, including CORS setup, helmet configuration, and rate limiting. It also contains helper functions for managing CORS whitelist origins and handling different environment variables related to security policies.

methods.name: toOriginMaybe
methods.description: Normalizes a URL-like string to an origin (scheme://host[:port]) or returns null if invalid.

methods.name: corsMiddleware
methods.description: Builds and returns an Express middleware function for handling CORS with a dynamic whitelist based on environment variables.

methods.name: helmetMiddleware
methods.description: Creates a Helmet middleware with a relaxed Content Security Policy to facilitate Swagger UI and cross-origin resources.

methods.name: rateLimiter
methods.description: Configures and returns an Express rate limiting middleware, with options coming from environment variables.
